Name: If It Fits I Ships - Cat in a Box Shipping Bin
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
[center][size=5]Hey, Hi, Howdy, and Hello
[/size][/center]Wickedy here and I just LOVE cats. I felt the need, no, the CALLING to make a kitty in a cardboard box in place of a shipping bin, so here you go! You can configure this to have any of the three default cats grab your goodies and take them to wherever kitties take things to. Works just like a normal shipping bin, because it's just a reskin on the shipping bin.

Please enjoy If It Fits I Ships, and feel free to adjust the assets as you see fit to include your own cat.
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Tl31qqt.png[/img]﻿

[/center]Change the cat type easier with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
